data.title: 远坂凛 · 都市追逐
data.description: 【远坂凛 · 都市追逐】深夜被阴影笼罩的冬木市街道上，凛在屋顶与巷弄间轻盈跃动，指尖已然夹紧了三枚蓄满魔力的纯净红宝石。她眼眸凌厉地紧盯着前方的暗影——「敢在我的领地里随意伤害无辜之人……看来有必要让你见识一下远坂家正统魔术的威力了！」
data.action: 跃过冬木屋顶间隙，一手夹紧三枚红宝石，另一手展开保持平衡，准备追击
data.lighting: deep night shadows and cold moonlight
data.camera: full-body action shot, horizontal framing, three gems and landing ledge visible
data.promptProse: Rin leaps across a narrow gap between Fuyuki rooftops at midnight, three small red gems held securely between the fingers of one hand. Her other arm extends for balance while her eyes follow the next landing ledge. The long sleeves and softly glowing circuits of the selected mage outfit trace the motion; she is carrying charged gems rather than firing a fingertip beam. Cold moonlight defines the roof edges, with small ruby reflections close to her hand. Use a wide horizontal frame showing her full airborne figure and destination ledge, without injured opponents or lettering.
